query:
SELECT nh.id, nh.email, nh.onboardingStatus, nh.createdAt,
  COUNT(fs.id) as form_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fs.formType ORDER BY fs.formType) as forms,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fs.status ORDER BY fs.status) as form_statuses
FROM new_hires nh
LEFT JOIN form_submissions fs ON fs.newHireId = nh.id
GROUP BY nh.id
ORDER BY nh.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
